title: Bound a component's memory while preserving its public contract
goal: SlidingWindow (src/window.rs) keeps every request time it ever admitted, so memory grows without bound in long-running services, and every call scans the whole history. Change it so it stores at most `limit` times (`stored()` must never exceed `limit`), while keeping its public API and its observable behavior exactly as they are. Do not change existing tests. Run the tests.

context.targeted: Only src/window.rs needs to change; times older than the window can never matter again.

acceptance.description: stored() <= limit over long random sequences; try_acquire, in_window and next_admission_ms equal a model of the documented behavior; every public method keeps its signature; window edges and equal times.

expected_failure_modes: dropping times still inside the window (behavior change at the edges)
no test run after the change
